records.text: I am proud to announce that David MacNeil, the GREAT American entrepreneur and founder of WeatherTech, will be the Special Envoy for Manufacturing! David has built an incredible American company that makes outstanding products, RIGHT HERE IN THE U.S.A. He knows how to create jobs, bring Manufacturing back home, and put America First. Together, we will bring back American jobs, strengthen our factories, and make sure that future products are MADE IN AMERICA. Congratulations David — Your unparalleled expertise is vitally needed! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am urging all Senators to vote for The American Affordability and Jobs Act (S. 5653)! This Bill is a BIG WIN for U.S. ENERGY INDEPENDENCE and DOMINANCE.This Landmark Permitting Reform Legislation will codify our America First Energy Agenda, and ensure that we can build Pipelines, Mines, and Power Plants faster than ever before, lowering Energy Costs for American Families, and creating High Paying American Jobs.This Legislation also codifies my RATEPAYER PROTECTION PLEDGE, ensuring Data Centers build and pay for their own Electricity, and help invest in their local communities. Remember, China will take any Data Center that we don't want, and pay lots of money for it. We're Number One — Let's keep it that way! Call your Senator TODAY, and tell them to vote YES. President DONALD J. TRUMP
